Google's approach to sustainability is organized around three key pillars: empowering individuals to take action, collaborating with partners and customers, and operating the business sustainably. They aim to help individuals make more sustainable choices through features in their products, such as eco-friendly routing in Google Maps and energy efficiency features in Google Nest thermostats. In 2022, Google reached its goal of helping 1 billion people make more sustainable choices and aspires to help reduce 1 gigaton of carbon equivalent emissions annually by 2030.

Additionally, Google focuses on protecting and enhancing nature and biodiversity through responsible sourcing and building for biodiversity at their campuses. They also engage employees in sustainability initiatives and provide opportunities for them to contribute to environmental issues. Overall, Google seeks to leverage its technology and platforms to drive broader environmental action beyond its own operations.
